subject: Standalone Workload Mode Framework, AIMode, RenderMode, GameMode coexistence, mandatory FA3 admission and global mode visibility
owner_approval_context: Approved directly in the Workload Mode planning conversation on 2026-10-02.
rules: Standalone Workload Mode remains independently usable without FA3.
Every FA3 installation profile must install and enable the compatible Workload Mode core and FA3 bridge.
AIMode and RenderMode share one broker/state/safety/lease core.
GameMode remains optional but is detected and coordinated when installed.
Every supported primary graphical surface inherits the shared Workload Mode indicator.
Missing or unhealthy Workload Mode cannot silently appear as a healthy FA3 installation.
